definition: Semantic object types shared across business tables; not activities or case instances.
encoding_detail: Type, identity or context only; does not store an event.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE object_type(type_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, type_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, definition TEXT NOT NULL)

definition: Globally unique object identities and their semantic types; no events are stored here.
encoding_detail: Type, identity or context only; does not store an event.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE object(object_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, type_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES object_type(type_code), UNIQUE(object_id,type_code))

definition: Synthetic patient identity, inspired by MIMIC subject_id.
encoding_detail: Type, identity or context only; does not store an event.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE patients(subject_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, object_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES object(object_id), gender TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(gender IN ('F','M')))

definition: Distinct hospital stays per patient with actual admission/discharge milestones.
encoding_detail: Actual one-time milestones are separate timestamp columns on the business object. NULL means not occurred.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE admissions(hadm_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(subject_id), object_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES object(object_id), edregtime TEXT, admittime TEXT NOT NULL, discharge_authorized_at TEXT, dischtime TEXT, UNIQUE(hadm_id,subject_id), CHECK(edregtime IS NULL OR edregtime<=admittime), CHECK(dischtime IS NULL OR discharge_authorized_at<=dischtime))

definition: Authored common parent for laboratory, medication and procedure orders; not a MIMIC table.
foreign_keys: hadm_id → admissions.hadm_id; subject_id → admissions.subject_id; object_id → object.object_id
encoding_detail: Type, identity or context only; does not store an event.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE clinical_order(object_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES object(object_id), subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL, hadm_id INTEGER NOT NULL, order_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(order_kind IN ('LAB','MED','PROC')), UNIQUE(object_id,order_kind), FOREIGN KEY(hadm_id,subject_id) REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id,subject_id))

definition: Authored laboratory-order subtype; several measurements may belong to one order.
encoding_detail: Actual one-time milestones are separate timestamp columns on the business object. NULL means not occurred.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE lab_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, object_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, order_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LAB' CHECK(order_kind='LAB'), specimen_received_at TEXT, results_verified_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(object_id,order_kind) REFERENCES clinical_order(object_id,order_kind))

definition: Authored medication-order subtype; repeated doses belong to one order.
encoding_detail: Actual one-time milestones are separate timestamp columns on the business object. NULL means not occurred.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE medication_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, object_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, order_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MED' CHECK(order_kind='MED'), medication TEXT NOT NULL, dispensed_at TEXT, stopped_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(object_id,order_kind) REFERENCES clinical_order(object_id,order_kind))

definition: Authored procedure-order subtype; repeated execution episodes belong to one order.
encoding_detail: Actual one-time milestones are separate timestamp columns on the business object. NULL means not occurred.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE procedure_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, object_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, order_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PROC' CHECK(order_kind='PROC'), procedure_name TEXT NOT NULL, preparation_completed_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(object_id,order_kind) REFERENCES clinical_order(object_id,order_kind))

definition: Repeated order actions, inspired by provider order transaction semantics; not a copy of poe.
encoding_detail: Each occurrence is a separate row; action/event_txt determines activity. Technical emar.storetime is excluded.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE order_history(history_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, object_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinical_order(object_id), action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('ENTERED','REVIEWED','CANCELLED')), occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL)

definition: Measurement occurrences with separately charted and available-result times, inspired by MIMIC labevents.

definition: Procedure execution episodes with start/end times, inspired by MIMIC procedureevents.
encoding_detail: Each row preserves a repeated occurrence; multiple timestamp columns emit distinct activity types within that occurrence.
